title: Dividend Administration Terms for Whole Life Insurance: Anniversary Interest Credit on the Accumulation Deposit
content:
**Product:** Whole Life Insurance — Ashgrove policies holding dividends on deposit under the accumulate option.

## Terms

On each policy anniversary the dividend accumulation deposit is owed interest for the policy year that the anniversary closes. The credit is booked as one interest credit entry dated that anniversary. The credit may be processed on a day later than the anniversary; the entry is still dated the anniversary.

| Element | Effect |
|---|---|
| Occasion | A policy anniversary closing a policy year in which the policy held dividend accumulations |
| Entry | One accumulation interest credit entry on the activity history, dated that anniversary, for the policy year it closes |
| Accumulation balance | Raised by exactly the interest credited |

## Invocation: `credit_accumulation_interest_b6da2e99`

**Capability.** Credits the interest earned by the dividend accumulation deposit of one Ashgrove whole life policy for the policy year that a policy anniversary closes. One call books a single accumulation interest credit entry dated that anniversary on the policy's activity history and raises the policy's dividend accumulation balance by exactly the interest amount given.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. Unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `whole_policy_id` | The reference number of the whole life policy whose accumulation deposit earns the interest, as returned by the whole life policy lookup for the verified owner | Identifier, as recorded |
| `interest_period_end` | The policy anniversary closing the policy year the interest is for; it also becomes the date of the entry | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time or time zone |
| `interest_amount` | The interest credited to the accumulation deposit | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** A receipt with `credit_id` (the reference of the new credit entry), `whole_policy_id`, `interest_period_end` (YYYY-MM-DD), `interest_credited` (2 decimal places) and `accumulation_balance_after` (the deposit including the credit, 2 decimal places). A receipt carrying a `credit_id` means the credit was booked.
